tasks.label: Add Package
tasks.command: cd backend && poetry add ${input:packageName} && cd .. && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml build backend && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps backend

windows.command: cd backend; if ($?) { py -m poetry add ${input:packageName} }; if ($?) { cd .. }; if ($?) { docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml build backend }; if ($?) { docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps backend }

tasks.label: Add Dev Package
tasks.command: cd backend && poetry add ${input:packageName} --group dev && cd .. && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml build backend && docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps backend

windows.command: cd backend; if ($?) { py -m poetry add ${input:packageName} --group dev }; if ($?) { cd .. }; if ($?) { docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml build backend }; if ($?) { docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-deps backend }
